name: Yuganda Ai Shika Shimesenakatta Ore o Yurushite.
original_name: 歪んだ愛しか示せなかった俺を許して。
source:
--the protagonist, Nishina Sougo, is in a friends-with-benefits relationship with his childhood friend, Kaihou Tsumugi.
Sougo had just recently gotten a girlfriend, and wants to cut off his and Tsumugi's distorted relationship, but due to some past circumstances, he can't do it.

After dragging this relationship along day by day, Sougo discovers something unbelievable.

[Translated from [url=https://tubumame.booth.pm/items/958258]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
——主人公仁科总悟与青梅竹马的紬海凤是好友关系。
总悟刚刚有了女朋友，想要斩断自己和紬之间扭曲的关系，但碍于过去的一些情况，他无法做到。

这段关系日复一日地拖下去后，总吾发现了一些难以置信的事情。

[译自[url=https://tubumame.booth.pm/items/958258]BOOTH[/url]]
